newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile regulator halts trade in Enersis affiliates.
newsitem.headline: Chile regulator halts trade in Enersis affiliates.

text.p: Chilean regulators on Wednesday halted trading in shares of investment firms linked to Enersis SA amid concerns that privileged information was leaked, market sources said.
The Stocks and Values Superintendency suspended trading in the Chispa, Almendros, Luz and Luz y Fuerza companies, the sources told Reuters.
The superintendency took the decision because information may have filtered into the market about possible talks on an alliance between Enersis and Spanish electricity utility Endesa, they said.
Luz y Fuerza was up 5.49 percent midsession at 173 pesos, Chispauno was up 5.36 percent at 177 pesos, and Almendros rose 4.85 percent to 173 pesos.
Enersis controls Chile's largest power generator Endesa and the electricity distributor Chilectra .
